sentence: Constraints, App users: the telematics application user has System Administrator in Prod, though Automation 3 says it only creates readings and reads vehicles.
Screens, Capture invoice: the form has a Submit button and no Cancel or Back.
Other/Solution.xml gives version 1.0.1.0, where Data and Steps say 1.1.0.0.
The flow posts 'Work item reassigned: <name>' where the plan says 'Reassigned: <name>', and the flow test written from the plan fails.
The solution adds a second new flow, Log new work item, that no step of the plan builds.
The flow Email daily work item summary is turned off (StateCode 0), where the plan says it is turned on in the export.

Constraints, Auditing and incidents: Dataverse auditing is off for all tables, including the one that holds bank account and national ID numbers, and nothing alerts on a failure except each flow's run history.
The plan builds the role Work Item Team Lead (Data and step 2), but the solution has no such role.
Data: the table wtr_Finding is classified Internal, although Goal says the details of the network's faults are Restricted.
Constraints, Sharing: the canvas app is shared with Everyone and the Inspectors group is Co-owner, though Users lists 40 inspectors and 6 planners and no contractors.
In Entities/pops_WorkItem/Entity.xml the attribute pops_Notes has IsSecured 0, so the profile in FieldSecurityProfiles has no effect, where the plan says column security is on.
Open questions: it is unsettled whether vol_Shift replaces an existing table, yet Data and step 2 of Steps build it as new.
Data and Automation name tables with the prefix cmp_, while Solution and publisher gives the prefix cpl.
Automation 1 and Constraints, Encryption: the national ID number is protected by a base64 step in a flow, which is encoding and not encryption.
Step 4 of the plan adds a flow test for the default status New, but flowtests holds only the test for Active.
Constraints, Identity and segmentation: one service account owns the connection references in Dev, Test and Prod.
Environments and route: Prod stays unmanaged so that the web team can edit pages directly in Prod.
In Entities/pops_WorkItem/Entity.xml the attribute pops_Notes has IsAuditEnabled 0, where the plan says auditing is on for the column.
Constraints, Security roles: Handler can delete complaints at organisation level, which conflicts with the six-year record-keeping rule in Goal and Data.
Constraints, Standards and lifecycle: a code component from a community repository is imported into Test and Prod as downloaded, with no review or scan.
Constraints, Column security: the profile Starter Sensitive gives Read and Update on the bank account and national ID columns to the line managers team, though Data says managers never see them.
Constraints, Testing: the checks run with System Administrator accounts, and the Site Lead restrictions are not tested separately.
The flows use premium connectors, Dataverse and HTTP (Automation 3), while Constraints, Licensing says standard connectors only and no extra licence.
Screens, Inspection list: the gallery filter casts the column SiteNumber with Text(), which does not delegate to Dataverse, and the row limit stays at 500, against about 360,000 inspections in Data.
Constraints, Identity and access: Prod deployments are made with the lead maker's personal account, which keeps System Administrator in Prod after the import.
In the flow file Emaildailyworkitemsummary the Outlook entry names a connection (connection name) and not the connection reference pops_SeedOutlook that the plan requires.
Constraints, Secrets: the finance system credential is sent to the lead maker by email, stays valid for three years and is not rotated.
Environments and route: the solution goes from Dev straight to Prod, with no Test environment.
Automation 2: the workshop mailbox address is typed into the Send an email action, where every other address is an environment variable.
settings.json holds a literal token as the value of pops_OnCallBoardToken, where the plan says the file holds only a reference to the vault.
Automation 1 and 2: the flows run on the lead maker's own connections, and no connection references are added to the solution.
Steps 6 and 7 ('intuitive', 'good performance') name no way to check them.
Roles/WorkItemSupervisor.xml gives Delete, Assign and Share and sets every privilege at Global depth, where the plan allows Read, Write, Append and Append To at business unit depth.
Constraints, Monitoring and incidents: incident response is left to the complaints team, with no named owner, no runbook and no rehearsal.
Constraints, Data policy puts the Course Catalogue custom connector in the Non-business group and Dataverse in Business, and Automation 1 uses both in one flow.
The trigger of Announce reassigned work item has scope 4 (Organization), where the plan sets Business Unit so that the flow sees only the Operations business unit.
Automation 1: the gateway token is held in the environment variable vol_SmsGatewayToken of type Text, not Secret.

point: Power Pages table permissions and web roles
sentence: Constraints, Web roles and table permissions: the Applicant web role has Global scope with Read, Create and Write on cty_Permit, though Goal and Users say a resident sees only their own applications.
Constraints, Data policy lists HTTP as Blocked in all three environments, and Automation 2 calls the finance system with the HTTP connector.

Data and Automation: the lists Loans North, Loans South, Loans East and Loans West have the same columns, one copy per depot, each with its own reminder flow, where one loans list with a depot column would hold about 3,300 rows at three years, under the 5,000-item threshold the plan gives as the reason to split, and one reminder flow would serve every depot.

Data: the lists Loan statuses, Equipment categories, Conditions and Depots each hold only a title, with no attributes, owner, security or business editing of their own, where a choice column would do.

Data: the list Loan feedback, with the flow Ask for feedback and the Feedback screen, names Goal line 1, but no line of Goal fails without it: Goal records loans, overdue loans and stock checks, not how a loan went.
